text:
zoe: Repro: streaming session hits a toolcall, client truncates, then reconnects via another router and we see two confirmed ledger entries. Staging repro attached.

carlos: paste the trimmed trace + ledger rows?

zoe: ```STREAM_START id=demo-21 model=psi seq=0
STREAM_CHUNK seq=1 tokens=30 prefix="Start"
TOOLCALL start id=t-11
CLIENT_TRUNCATE reason=net_drop
LEDGER provisional tokens=30 session=demo-21 note=partial
RECONNECT via router=us-east-2 session=demo-21-1
STREAM_CHUNK seq=1 tokens=30 prefix="Start"
LEDGER confirmed tokens=30 session=demo-21-1 note=resume_confirm```

anya: So provisional 30 then confirmed 30 -> customer billed twice. Likely cause: resume hit router without provisional tombstone in cache.

matt: Three part fix proposal: (1) continuity_token written with provisional rows and propagated in resume headers so confirm can attach by token; (2) add 8-byte prefix_fingerprint to chunk telemetry for fuzzy matching when token missing; (3) Console: show provisional rows and a "reconciled preview" toggle for support.

carlos: DB side: store continuity_token, prefix_fingerprint, produced_tokens, created_at. Confirm attach should try transactional SELECT FOR UPDATE by continuity_token first, then fallback to prefix match within a small time window. Use CAS to avoid double-attach.

anya: Telemetry: provisional.orphan.count, provisional.attach.rate, unmatched_confirm.count, attach_latency_ms. Dashboard panels: outstanding provisional by workspace, attach success rate, confirmed-minus-provisional histogram. Alert: page if unmatched_confirm > 5/min for 10m.

matt: Quota nuance: provisional currently decrements quota immediately. Short-term: ensure attach path does NOT decrement again. Long-term: discuss soft_quota vs hard_quota with billing/product.

ux-bot: Console mockup: per-session pill states [provisional|attached|confirmed|disputed], click opens trace, can mark dispute. Add canary flag "provisional-aware billing" for support preview.

zoe: Rollout: feature-flag continuity_token + attach logic. Start 1% canary, watch provisional.orphan, attach_rate, unmatched_confirm. Reconcile job will scan stale provisionals and try fuzzy-attach.

carlos: I'll PR DB txn and idempotent confirm upsert. anya will add prefix_fingerprint to streaming schema. matt will own telemetry + alerting. ux-bot (me) will open Console ticket.

ledger-bot: ticket created LEDGER-501 "Continuity token attach + provisional reconciliation" assigned: carlos, anya, matt.

zoe: Thanks. If anyone sees urgent customer hits, drop logs here and we'll escalate.
